theme.border_radius: 0.75rem (rounded-xl) for cards, 1rem (rounded-2xl) for primary buttons and modals

navigation.top_bar: Sticky header with logo SOCLE Artisan, badge 'Martin Rénovation', quick stats summary, data-testid='top-nav'
navigation.mobile_bottom_bar: Fixed bottom bar on mobile with 4 tactile tabs: Tableau de bord, Devis, Nouveau IA (+ highlight), Clients

dashboard.hero_section: Card 'À traiter aujourd'hui' highlighting quotes requiring immediate action or follow-up
dashboard.quick_cta: Big tactile button 'Nouveau devis IA' with mic icon and pulse effect

new_quote_ia_wizard.step_1_client: Form fields for Client info (Nom, Téléphone, Email, Adresse du chantier) with quick pre-fill mock client button
new_quote_ia_wizard.step_2_description_and_mic: Large high-contrast textarea 'Décrivez le chantier' + prominent Micro dictation button with live animated waveform simulator
new_quote_ia_wizard.step_3_ai_analyzer: Button 'Analyser avec l'IA' with simulated multi-step AI parsing progress (extracting prestations, quantities, TVA rates)
new_quote_ia_wizard.step_4_line_editor: Structured line items table with editable Designation, Quantité, Unité (m², h, forfait, ens.), Prix Unitaire HT, and TVA dropdown (5.5%, 10%, 20%)
new_quote_ia_wizard.totals_box: Instant reactive calculation box showing Total HT, Total TVA, and Total TTC

quote_preview.document_style: Professional printable French quote sheet format with SIRET, Legal mentions, Client box, itemized table, total summary, signature block
quote_preview.actions: Buttons for Enregistrer, Imprimer/PDF, Envoyer par SMS/Email, Marquer Accepté

relance_modal.content: Pre-filled polite SMS/Email message template with client name, quote reference, amount, and direct approval link simulation

component_guidelines.buttons: Large touch target (minimum 48px height, default 52px), rounded-xl, bold label, clear icon
component_guidelines.inputs: Height 48px, high contrast borders, clear labels and placeholder examples suitable for field tradespeople
component_guidelines.cards: Clean white background with soft petrol tint border, generous internal padding (p-4 to p-6)
component_guidelines.status_badges: High visibility pill badges for Brouillon, Envoyé, À relancer, Accepté

testing.requirement: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, status pills, and calculated totals MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='new-quote-button', data-testid='total-ttc-display').
